[Doc 2] Garajonay National Park: Garajonay National Park (Spanish: "Parque nacional de Garajonay" , ] ) is located in the center and north of the island of La Gomera, one of the Canary Islands (Spain).

[Doc 3] Garajonay National Park:  It occupies 40 km (15 sq mi) and it extends into each of the six municipalities on the island.

[Doc 4] Adenocarpus viscosus:  It can be found above 1800 m on two of the islands, La Palma in Caldera de Tabouriente and Tenerife where it is a dominant shrub in Teide National Park and occurs in parts of Corona Forestal Nature Park and Reserva Especial de las Palomas.
